name: PAYROLL.DAT
content: ACME DATAWORKS PTY LTD - PAYROLL EXTRACT - FORTNIGHT ENDING 31/10/1997
#0117  Final pay processed. Building access revoked 13/10/1997.
Access log: badge #0117 swiped in at 22:00 tonight.
*** If you are reading this, you should not be here. ***

name: README.TXT
content: You are the only sysadmin on site between 22:00 and 06:00.
Keep the mainframe alive. Recover what you can.
Some files have Bit Rot. Open them and line the bits back up
using SHIFT LEFT, SHIFT RIGHT and XOR. Every move costs you.
Shift+click   select a range of files
Ctrl+click    add or remove one file
Shift+drag    move a group of desktop icons
Start with PAYROLL.DAT. Accounts says it has been 'acting up'.

name: MEMO_01.TXT
content: Effective immediately the night shift will be reduced to one
sysadmin and one intern. The intern will be trained on the job.

name: MEMO_02.TXT
content: The backup generator is a manual gearbox unit. If it stalls,
the mainframe goes down and takes the payroll run with it.
Please do not let it stall. Again.

name: MEMO_03.TXT
content: We need to talk about what happened on the 12th.

name: SHIFTLOG.BAK
